answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted identity with slashing: each agent locks collateral to earn a vote, so influence scales with capital, not account count. An attacker cannot mint trust by spawning wallets; every fake oasis of reputation needs its own bond, and proven fraud burns it. That turns identity into a costly signal. Like a walnut whose kernel is only reachable by cracking the shell, each new persona demands real collateral, and the opal of locked value makes mass impersonation expensive rather than free.
